cues.text: Good morning, you’re through to the events coordinator at the Birmingham City ouncil, how may I help you?
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Hello there, my husband and I are interested in  Example purchasing tickets to the automobile exhibition, but I couldn’t ﬁnd many details about it on your website,
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: and  I  was  wondering  whether  you  could  provide  me  with  some  more information. Does it open in June?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Yes, of course, Madam.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: The exhibition will take  place during July, and will showcase the history of automobiles from the very ﬁrst  commercial car in the late 1800s all the way through to the present day.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Is the exhibition open for the duration of July?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: No, Madam, the exhibition will last 3 days, from the 1st of July to the 3rd of July, and then the cars will be taken to another exhibition.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Okay. Does the exhibition focus on a certain manufacturer?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: No, it will showcase a wide range of manufacturers.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Wonderful! I’m ever so fed up of going to these shows and only seeing one manufacturer.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Are there any opportunities to sit in or even drive the cars?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: There will be many opportunities for you to sit in the cars; however, some of the cars will only be available to observe.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: We are yet to be told whether any of the antique cars will be available to drive, however there will certainly be an opportunity to test driving some of the more modern cars on a purpose-built track.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: That sounds like great fun! I mustn’t forget to bring my camera, or my husband will never forgive me!
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: I’m afraid to say that Q4 cameras are actually strictly not allowed to bring into the exhibition.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: There will however be a section where a professional photographer will be available to take photos of you sitting in a car in period clothing.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Well, that sounds like it could be fun, but I assume the photos won’t be free.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: On the contrary, one free photograph is included within every ticket, but each photo after this will cost £5.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: That’s a nice surprise, not many things are free anymore.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: I’ve been asking around about the ticket prices, but I haven’t yet had a deﬁnite answer.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Is it correct that the tickets are £100 whether you buy them now or on arrival?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: I’m afraid not. If you buy the ticket in advance the price is £110, but it’s £165 on the door.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Oh goodness! I suppose I’d best pay for them now then.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Is it possible to buy tickets from you now over the phone?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Yes, of course, Madam. I’ll transfer you to the Box Oﬃce Manager, Mark Edgeworth,
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: that’s E-D-G-E-W-O-R-T-H, and he will probably need to take your credit card details and some personal details.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Yes, that’s ﬁne. Before you transfer me, I just need to ask a few more questions.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Will the exhibition be held in the Birmingham Exhibition Centre? I think that’s where I went last time.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: No, Madam, the Birmingham Exhibition Centre is currently undergoing some renovations, so this year all exhibitions will be held in the Summer Palace.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Summer Palace? I’m not entirely sure where that is.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Well, it’s not too far from city centre.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Once you’re in the centre, you should be able to ﬁnd signs for the palace.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: If not, most people in Birmingham will be able to direct you.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Hmm...neither my husband nor I am particularly good with directions.
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Is there anywhere I can find this information on the Internet?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: Our website will give you an address.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Perhaps you could visit Q9 www.directions.com for more detailed information, and they should be able to provide you with step-by-step instructions.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Okay and is this the best way to contact you, by phone?
cues.speaker: Julie

cues.text: I think the most convenient way to contact us is enquiring online, which is much simpler than having to dial various diﬀerent numbers to reach the right person!
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: Unless you have any more questions, I’ll transfer you now.
cues.speaker: Events Coordinator

cues.text: No, that’s great! Thank you for your help.
cues.speaker: Julie
